reason: My clients already send me receipts on WhatsApp and I key them into Jurnal or Accurate. This puts them in a Google Sheet, so I'd still have to move everything into the books myself. It's one more place to look, not one less step.
objection: It stops at Google Sheets. If it doesn't export straight into Jurnal or Accurate, I'm doing the data entry twice, and I'd also have to get 20-odd clients to change how they send me things.
would_change_my_mind: A one-click export or import file that goes straight into Jurnal or Accurate, mapped to my clients' accounts, so the receipts end up in the books without me re-keying them.
